summary: Researched Fluence Energy as one immutable storage-system security. Record backlog, higher deployment, and improved quarterly margin support a causal grid-storage exposure, but first-half operating cash use, project-cost revisions, thin adjusted EBITDA guidance, warranty exposure, and the absence of a fresh deterministic mark prevent a supportable valuation or strategy. Updated the security to watching and queued one bounded relationship review.

evidence.claim: For the quarter ended 31 March 2026, Fluence reported USD 464.9 million revenue, 10.0% GAAP gross margin, a USD 29.2 million net loss, USD 5.6 billion backlog, and USD 900 million of management-defined liquidity while reaffirming fiscal-2026 guidance.

evidence.source: Fluence Energy SEC Form 10-Q for 31 March 2026
evidence.claim: First-half operating cash use was USD 347.9 million and company-defined free-cash-flow use was USD 285.4 million; management attributed gross-margin pressure to US project cost increases, delays, and scope revisions.

evidence.source: Fluence Energy SEC Form 10-Q warranty note
evidence.claim: At 31 March 2026, gross warranty liabilities were USD 54.8 million and net liabilities after expected supplier recoveries were USD 28.8 million; actual failure and replacement costs remain estimation risks.

daily_report_items: Fluence Energy moved to watching: storage backlog and quarterly margin improved, but first-half cash burn, project-cost revisions, warranty exposure, no fresh deterministic mark, and no supportable valuation block a strategy; one causal relationship review was queued.
